checks: Existing eight demo slots remain empty declarations without copied dimensions or fictitious identities.
Started and complete refer to declared fields, never connected or physically qualified hardware.
Operation time and previous revision produce an immutable deterministic record.
Invented connection, qualification, schema and revision fields are rejected instead of persisted.
Physical dimensions require three positive finite numbers; strings and incomplete axes cannot imply a build volume.
Interface addresses carry no credentials or command schemes and make no network request.
Documented tests require a real calendar date, a named operator and a report reference.
A changed preparation configuration cannot silently reuse a documented test as current evidence.
File formats are deduplicated extensions and cannot carry a path or executable command.
The rendered form starts blank, keeps a captured revision and round-trips through native FormData.
User-supplied names and notes cannot insert executable markup in cards or form values.
The inventory grid and export retain slots without relabeling a demo profile as detected hardware.
